title.zh: 三星钱包与Solana合作支持USDC支付与跨境汇款
title.en: Samsung Wallet Partners with Solana for USDC Payments and Remittances

current_state.zh: 三星Wallet将于2026年10月底添加Sui上的USDC，并使其成为美国用户默认美元稳定币；将支持向兼容钱包发送USDC并通过Bastion基础设施在60多个国家提现至银行账户；托管由Bastion和Coinbase Prime（NYDFS合规）提供；覆盖美国8200万台兼容Galaxy设备，用户需身份验证；Solana和Sui为技术合作伙伴；对外部钱包转账免手续费，国际银行转账收费；未来可能支持线上和店内稳定币支付。
current_state.en: Samsung Wallet will add USDC on Sui in late October 2026 and make it the default dollar stablecoin for US users; it will enable USDC transfers to compatible wallets and off-ramp to bank accounts in 60+ countries via Bastion infrastructure; custody is provided by Bastion and Coinbase Prime (NYDFS-compliant); available on 82 million compatible Galaxy devices in the US with identity verification; Solana and Sui are technical partners; no fee for transfers to external wallets, international bank transfers incur fees; future online and in-store stablecoin payments may follow.

updates.title_zh: 三星钱包将为美国符合条件的Galaxy用户提供稳定币访问
updates.title_en: Samsung Wallet to Bring Stablecoin Access to Eligible Galaxy Users in the US
updates.what_changed_zh: 三星宣布，三星钱包将为美国符合条件的Galaxy用户提供稳定币访问，将稳定币支付与持有扩展至主流消费硬件用户群体。
updates.what_changed_en: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin payments/holding to a mainstream consumer hardware audience.
updates.current_state_zh: 三星宣布，三星钱包将为美国符合条件的Galaxy用户提供稳定币访问，将稳定币支付与持有扩展至主流消费硬件用户群体。
updates.current_state_en: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin payments/holding to a mainstream consumer hardware audience.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin payments/holding to a mainstream consumer hardware audience.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin payments/holding to a mainstream consumer hardware audience.

updates.title_zh: 三星与Solana合作，三星钱包用户将可使用Solana上的USDC进行跨境汇款
updates.title_en: 三星与Solana合作，三星钱包用户将可使用Solana上的USDC进行跨境汇款
updates.what_changed_zh: 三星与Solana达成合作，将基于Solana的USDC稳定币支付引入其美国三星钱包用户，覆盖8200万台Galaxy设备，从10月最后一周起支持跨境汇款。
updates.what_changed_en: Samsung has partnered with Solana to bring Solana-based USDC stablecoin payments to its US Samsung Wallet users across 82 million Galaxy devices, enabling cross-border remittances starting in the final week of October.
updates.current_state_zh: 三星与Solana达成合作，将基于Solana的USDC稳定币支付引入其美国三星钱包用户，覆盖8200万台Galaxy设备，从10月最后一周起支持跨境汇款。
updates.current_state_en: Samsung has partnered with Solana to bring Solana-based USDC stablecoin payments to its US Samsung Wallet users across 82 million Galaxy devices, enabling cross-border remittances starting in the final week of October.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Samsung has partnered with Solana to bring Solana-based USDC stablecoin payments to its US Samsung Wallet users across 82 million Galaxy devices, enabling cross-border remittances starting in the final week of October.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Samsung has partnered with Solana to bring Solana-based USDC stablecoin payments to its US Samsung Wallet users across 82 million Galaxy devices, enabling cross-border remittances starting in the final week of October.

updates.title_zh: 三星钱包将于10月底在Sui上添加USDC
updates.title_en: Samsung Wallet to Add USDC on Sui in Late October
updates.what_changed_zh: Samsung Wallet 将具体在10月底添加 Sui 上的 USDC，由 Bastion 和 Coinbase 提供托管，并在60多个国家支持银行账户转账（单独收费）。
updates.what_changed_en: Samsung Wallet will specifically add USDC on Sui in late October, with Bastion and Coinbase providing custody and bank-account transfers in more than 60 countries (separate fees).
updates.current_state_zh: Samsung Wallet 将于10月底添加 Sui 上的 USDC，由 Bastion 和 Coinbase 提供托管，并在60多个国家支持银行账户转账。
updates.current_state_en: Samsung Wallet will add USDC on Sui in late October, with Bastion and Coinbase providing custody and bank-account transfers in more than 60 countries.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Samsung Wallet will add USDC on Sui in late October, with Bastion and Coinbase providing custody and bank-account transfers in more than 60 countries carrying separate fees.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Samsung Wallet will add USDC on Sui in late October, with Bastion and Coinbase providing custody and bank-account transfers in more than 60 countries carrying separate fees.

updates.title_zh: Coinbase将把USDC设为三星Wallet美国用户默认美元稳定币，预计10月底上线
updates.title_en: Coinbase将把USDC设为三星Wallet美国用户默认美元稳定币，预计10月底上线
updates.what_changed_zh: Coinbase宣布，自2026年10月最后一周起，USDC将成为三星Wallet美国用户默认的美元稳定币，并通过Coinbase Prime进行合规托管（符合NYDFS要求），Bastion提供支持。
updates.what_changed_en: Coinbase announced that from the last week of October 2026, USDC will become the default dollar stablecoin for US users of Samsung Wallet, with custody via Coinbase Prime under NYDFS-compliant qualified custody, supported by Bastion.
updates.current_state_zh: 三星Wallet将于10月底添加Sui上的USDC，并使其成为美国用户默认美元稳定币；托管由Bastion和Coinbase Prime（NYDFS合规）提供，并在60多个国家支持银行账户转账。
updates.current_state_en: Samsung Wallet will add USDC on Sui in late October and make it the default dollar stablecoin for US users; custody is provided by Bastion and Coinbase Prime (NYDFS-compliant), with bank-account transfers in more than 60 countries.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Coinbase announced that USDC will become the default dollar stablecoin for US users of Samsung Wallet from the last week of October 2026, with custody via Coinbase Prime and NYDFS-compliant qualified custody, supported by Bastion.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Coinbase announced that USDC will become the default dollar stablecoin for US users of Samsung Wallet from the last week of October 2026, with custody via Coinbase Prime and NYDFS-compliant qualified custody, supported by Bastion.

updates.title_zh: 三星钱包将于10月为美国Galaxy用户添加USDC转账功能
updates.title_en: Samsung Wallet to add USDC transfers for US Galaxy users in October
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充：USDC 转账功能将允许美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户向兼容钱包发送 USDC，并通过 Bastion 基础设施在 60 多个国家提现至银行账户；覆盖美国 8200 万台兼容 Galaxy 设备，用户需完成身份验证；Solana 和 Sui 被列为技术合作伙伴；向外部钱包转账免手续费，国际银行转账收费因目的地和金额而异；Borderless.xyz 负责 60 多国的支付；未来可能支持线上和店内稳定币支付。
updates.what_changed_en: New report adds: USDC transfers will let eligible US Galaxy users send USDC to compatible wallets and off-ramp to bank accounts in 60+ countries via Bastion infrastructure; available on 82 million compatible Galaxy devices in the US with identity verification; Solana and Sui named as technical partners; no fee for USDC transfers to external wallets, international bank transfers incur fees varying by destination and amount; Borderless.xyz handles payouts in 60+ countries; future online and in-store stablecoin payments may follow.
updates.current_state_zh: 三星Wallet将于2026年10月底添加Sui上的USDC，并使其成为美国用户默认美元稳定币；将支持向兼容钱包发送USDC并通过Bastion基础设施在60多个国家提现至银行账户；托管由Bastion和Coinbase Prime（NYDFS合规）提供；覆盖美国8200万台兼容Galaxy设备，用户需身份验证；Solana和Sui为技术合作伙伴；对外部钱包转账免手续费，国际银行转账收费；未来可能支持线上和店内稳定币支付。
updates.current_state_en: Samsung Wallet will add USDC on Sui in late October 2026 and make it the default dollar stablecoin for US users; it will enable USDC transfers to compatible wallets and off-ramp to bank accounts in 60+ countries via Bastion infrastructure; custody is provided by Bastion and Coinbase Prime (NYDFS-compliant); available on 82 million compatible Galaxy devices in the US with identity verification; Solana and Sui are technical partners; no fee for transfers to external wallets, international bank transfers incur fees; future online and in-store stablecoin payments may follow.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Samsung will enable USDC transfers in Samsung Wallet for eligible US Galaxy users in the last week of October, letting them send USDC to compatible wallets and off-ramp to bank accounts across 60+ countries via Bastion infrastructure with Coinbase as sub-custodian.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Samsung will enable USDC transfers in Samsung Wallet for eligible US Galaxy users in the last week of October, letting them send USDC to compatible wallets and off-ramp to bank accounts across 60+ countries via Bastion infrastructure with Coinbase as sub-custodian.
